package rulefixtures

import (
	"log/slog"
	"os"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_logging_overhead_logger_with_fields_per_request: Layer: Logging overhead. Flag derived logger construction per request when stable fields can be attached once.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
var baseLogger = slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(os.Stderr, nil))

func scenario562Positive(requestID string) {
	// A new derived logger is created for every request, allocating
	// a fresh logger with the request_id field. This is expensive at
	// high QPS. The handler-level logger should be reused.
	logger := baseLogger.With(slog.String("request_id", requestID))
	logger.Info("handling request")
}
